name: dobe_n1_bulk
desc: Keep the exact same colors, shading style, yellow marble streaks, head and calm face. Only make the body much bulkier and heavier: a much broader, thicker chest and wider shoulders, bigger thicker arms and fists, and a fatter, heavier, gooier lower body that melts into a much wider, thicker, glossy goo puddle with sagging drips everywhere. Same pixel art style.
